measurement_description: The paper did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured user experience inclusivity in Human-AI interaction based on five user problem-solving styles (attitudes toward risk, computer self-efficacy, motivations, information processing style, and learning style) and demographic diversity (gender and age).
